Saints & Masters Acquires Xencia, Eyes ₹1,000 Crore from Microsoft Cloud

Saints & Masters has acquired Xencia, a company focused on Microsoft cloud business. The acquisition aims to generate ₹1,000 crore in revenue. This move signals a strategic expansion for Saints & Masters within the cloud services sector.
